title: Sandboxed eval standup synthesis — Mar 06–09 2028
short_summary: Weekly standup capture for sandboxed eval stream. Focus: finishing compact-quant probe runs, triaging a KV-cache degradation after 4-bit rollout, and onboarding Orchid-1.2 for smoke and stability evals.
body:
Meeting: Sandboxed Eval standup (async + sync sync on 2028-03-06)
Owners: Priya (notes), Liam (bench infra), Maya (eval harness), Zhen (quant experiments)
Attendees: Priya, Liam, Maya, Zhen, Tomás, Erin (remote)

Highlights:
- KV-cache regression after early 4-bit rollout: observed increased soft-fail rate (~2.8% -> 6.9%) on long-context summarization tests. Repro on local microbatch runner. Initial hypothesis: rounding-induced key collisions in compact KV encoding when sequence-length > 4096. (See JIRA:RWI-APPLY-1342)
- Orchid-1.2 onboarding: model artifacts uploaded to staging model-registry. Tokenization mismatch found between HF checkpoint and our tokenizer wrapper (special token mapping). Maya added a quick patch to canonicalize token ids for the eval harness; smoke evals running.
- Compact quant probe finishing: zquant 4-bit experiments finished on 30k-step checkpoint; perplexity and QA eval differences look within expected band for most prompts but show drift on arithmetic reasoning prompts (failures on carry/borrow patterns).

Deep dives / notes:
1) KV-cache degradation (Liam, Zhen)
   - Repro steps: run long-context summarization (src: /bench/long-docs/clinical-10k.jsonl) with microbatch 8, prefix-caching enabled, quantized weights (4-bit). Failures spike after ~800 tokens in many runs.
   - Temporary mitigation: disable compact prefix packing in runtime when model is flagged as 'legacy-kv' in model-metadata. This reduces throughput ~7% but restores correctness.
   - Next: add a unit test for KV collision cases (edge-case sequences with repeated rare tokens) and fuzz the KV hash quantization rounding. Zhen to attach new fuzz corpus.
   - Tickets: RWI-APPLY-1342 (investigate), RWI-APPLY-1387 (hotfix for runtime flag)

2) Orchid-1.2 onboarding (Maya, Tomás)
   - Tokenizer mapping: found 3 special-token mismatches (</s>, <ref>, <meta>) between HF and our runtime wrapper. Patch in review at PR #278.
   - Eval plan: run smoke suite (sanity + perf) -> focused QA + summarization -> extended regression suite (120k prompts) on dedicated staging cluster. Expected schedule: smoke done by 3/10; full regression by 3/17.
   - Risk: Orchid-1.2 uses GELU-approx numerics that interact poorly with our current 4-bit scaling heuristics — need to include a model-specific quant config if drift observed.

3) Compact quant probe results (Zhen)
   - Summary metrics: Gen PPL delta +0.9% vs fp16; QA F1 median -0.7pts; arithmetic failure cases increased by 3x on specific prompt families.
   - Investigation pointers: look at activation clipping thresholds used during calibration; try per-channel scaling on MLP layers.
   - Action: run per-channel vs per-tensor ablation on next cluster cycle (Zhen owns).

Operational items / infra (Liam)
- Microbatch runner: deployed v0.9.3 with improved trace logs for KV stores. Logs now include kv-index snapshots for first 1024 tokens which should speed debug.
- Autoscaling tests on dedicated stage succeeded for 50->200 rps burst but we saw a small memory leak in bench harness (process RSS drift ~120MB/hour). Filed in infra backlog (JIRA:RWI-INF-442).

Open questions / asks
- Do we permit a temporary model-specific runtime flag to disable compact prefix packing for Orchid-1.2 only? (Pros: safety, quick rollout. Cons: fragmentation of runtime config.)
- Can SRE provide access to an extra staging GPU node for heavy Orchid regression runs next week? (Requesting 1xA100-sXM)

Action items (owner — due)
- Zhen: attach KV fuzz corpus and add unit tests for KV collisions (RWI-APPLY-1342) — due 2028-03-12
- Maya: merge tokenizer canonicalize patch (#278) and trigger smoke eval for Orchid-1.2 — due 2028-03-10
- Liam: temporarily add runtime model flag and rollout hotfix to staging (RWI-APPLY-1387) — due 2028-03-11
- Priya: collate arithmetic-fail prompt families and add to canonical regression set — due 2028-03-13
- Tomás: schedule dedicated staging node with SRE (follow-up in #infra-requests) — due 2028-03-09 (in-flight)

Notes-to-self / quick reminders:
- Keep compact-quant PRs small; prefer opt-in model configs rather than global heuristic changes.
- Add a perf regression dashboard tile for KV-cache soft-fail rate so we spot regressions earlier.

Appendix (useful links & references)
- Local repro script: bench/scripts/kv_repro_long.sh
- Fuzz corpus seed: bench/fuzz/kv-seed-v3.jsonl (Zhen will expand)
- Orchid onboarding confluence: confluence.redwood.ai/display/AM/Orchid-1.2+onboarding
- Related PR: github.com/redwood-inference/quant-playbooks/pull/278

Next sync: 2028-03-13 async writeup + synchronous triage if KV fixes incomplete.

End notes: This doc is intended as the canonical weekly capture for the sandboxed eval stream. Please add comments inline or ping in Slack if you need reassignments.
